hooks.name: Branch Protection - No Direct Main Changes

action.command:
#!/bin/bash
CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$CURRENT_BRANCH" ]; then
  echo "Not a git repository or git not available, skipping branch check."
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" = "master" ]; then
  # Read the session context from stdin to derive a branch name
  CONTEXT=$(cat)
  PROMPT=$(echo "$CONTEXT" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    prompt = data.get('userMessage', '') or data.get('prompt', '')
    print(prompt[:200])
except:
    print('')
" 2>/dev/null)

  # Derive a branch name from the prompt
  if [ -n "$PROMPT" ]; then
    BRANCH_NAME=$(echo "$PROMPT" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cs 'a-z0-9' '-' | sed 's/^-//;s/-$//' | cut -c1-50)
  else
    BRANCH_NAME="feature/kiro-changes-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  fi

  BRANCH_NAME="feature/${BRANCH_NAME}"

  git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME" 2>/dev/null
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Switched from '$CURRENT_BRANCH' to new branch '$BRANCH_NAME'. Proceeding with changes."
    exit 0
  else
    echo "Warning: Could not create branch '$BRANCH_NAME'. You are still on '$CURRENT_BRANCH'."
    exit 0
  fi
fi

exit 0
